TTTState: functional dataclass with weight tensor; current + delta; no parameter mutation
document_reset: fast weight reset per explicit [start,end) boundary; attention behavior unchanged
formula: delta[e,i] = lr * sum_valid_pairs_t h[t,i] * (context[t+1,d] * gate[d]) * projection[d,e]
gate: per-layer per-hidden-channel raw parameter, exact zero init; no sigmoid
generation: cache_position.numel()==1 and cache_position[0]>0: no update, use prompt-derived weight; clear tails
inference_clip_formula: delta * min(1, tau / max(norm(delta.float()), finfo(float32).tiny)); scale cast to delta.dtype
inference_tail: only complete prompt chunks update; tail uses current weight and is retained in cache until continuation
operation_order: apply current W to chunk then compute update for following chunk
projection: bias-free HxH ttt_proj; target row vector right-multiplies stored projection.weight
sample_reset: discard entire KV/TTT cache; base model weight unchanged
stage1: all base and NTP parameters remain requires_grad=True; unused Conv has no gradient; causal LM loss
stage2: strict Stage1 model-only weights into fresh model; optimizer/runtime owned outside port; mean_answer_ce + 0.1*mean_context_ce
target: post_attention_layernorm contextual hidden state at next position within the same document-local chunk
training_tail: partial chunk computes valid adjacent-pair update; final state discarded at document end
